rules: Inspect each repository read-only and cite concrete paths.
Record language, frameworks, dependencies, and structural patterns without recommending extraction.
Use the existing knowledge retrieval path for context but distinguish retrieved guidance from repository evidence.
acceptance_checks: Every claimed pattern cites at least one concrete source path.
Recon does not prematurely label code reusable.

rules: Separate stable invariant behavior from product-specific differences.
Reject false commonality and abstractions without a coherent ownership boundary.
acceptance_checks: Each retained pattern has multiple concrete consumers.
Confidence and evidence limits are explicit.

rules: Rank by portfolio benefit, stability, extraction cost, and migration risk.
Sketch the smallest public API that serves the proven common behavior.
Name source, first adopter, owner, staged migration, rollback, and verification.
acceptance_checks: No single-consumer helper is marketed as a portfolio library.
Each top candidate has a reversible first extraction step.
